input.quote: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation
input.rationale: The grant in Section 13 meets our preferred position: it covers Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, paid-up and embedded Vendor Technology is licensed perpetually and irrevocably (13.2), licence rights are transferable to an Affiliate or successor (13.3), and Vendor may only suspend or revoke during a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a cure opportunity. The one revocable, non-transferable licence (Section 14.2, Deliverables) is addressed by our IP redline rather than duplicated here.

input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours
input.rationale: Section 22 matches our preferred position: once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor under confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data or privileged material. Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains no additional inspection right binding us. No redline needed.
